title: The Door in the Middle of Town
rule: In this town, every day it rains something different.
ending: I pressed the red button. The lights went out and the screens turned to eyes. Outside, monsters rained over the plaza and the Mayor hid under his top hat. It flips line 1: now the town rains whatever I press.

planted.detail: Giant door with a gold keyhole in the middle of the town
Wall of cameras watching every street
Red button under a cover with the sign DON'T PRESS THAT, KID

lines.text: In this town, every day it rains something different.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Mondays it rains frogs. On Wednesdays, pillows.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Thursdays, it rains keys.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A giant door stands in the middle of our town.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone grabs keys and runs to the golden keyhole.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Key after key just clinks and falls.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then one key lands right in my hand.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I got the one. It slid in and turned.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The giant door swung open into bright light.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Inside, a wall of cameras showed every street in town.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The Mayor sat at the levers, controlling every weather.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He turned and said,
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Do not touch anything.
lines.speaker: mayor

lines.text: His big buttons read FRIDAY DROP, and MONSTERS.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Under a little cover sat a red one: DON'T PRESS THAT, KID.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I pressed it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The lights went out, and every screen turned to eyes.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Outside, the sky opened over the plaza.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It rained monsters: slimes, ghosts, and one very tall Long One.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The Mayor hid under his top hat, shaking.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: In this town, it rains whatever I press. What next?
lines.speaker: narrator
